provenance.cpu_taso_build_adaptation: Provider source-built official master with CPU CMake/config changes, one epsilon member qualification, three required cmath includes; -O1 -UNDEBUG. Public headers and graph optimization/rule source bytes unchanged. Full patch/audit/licenses included.
provenance.numerical_arithmetic: Exact Python mathematical integers, zero tolerance, includes explicit all-zero/all-negative inputs and 16 deterministic seed cases per graph; independent of egraph/TASO representation
provenance.offline_execution: Both configurations executed with AF_INET/AF_INET6 denied by inherited syscall guard, OMP/MKL threads=1, isolated Python -I -S -B
provenance.qualified_scope: Primary original TensorAnalysis + original CheckApply/rules_from_str + original TensorCost + author egg Runner/Extractor, real private TASO CPU runtime. Six graph families each with 18 exact-integer input sets, four negative cases, native metadata and independent C++/Rust ABI checks. Auxiliary author-IR/rules/egg AST-cost configuration separately checked.
provenance.source_adaptation: Complete 8-file patch. Original rewrites.rs and converted.txt unchanged; model.rs and optimize.rs only change BN signatures. New driver and input preflight are separate. Build.rs regenerates CPU FFI and legally encodes libclang anonymous DNNL names through bindgen ParseCallbacks. All 82 original Cargo package versions/checksums preserved, stale root name corrected.
provenance.vendored_resolution: Succeeded under offline syscall guard and a fresh empty Cargo home: 82 native and 21 auxiliary packages

requirements: Linux x86_64; recorded tests use CPython 3.12 standard library only
glibc >=2.34, libstdc++ providing GLIBCXX_3.4.32 and CXXABI_1.3.13 (recorded GCC 13 host)
Platform libgcc_s, libm, libgomp and libz; TASO/oneDNN/protobuf/OpenCL ICD loader are bundled privately
LD_LIBRARY_PATH={prefix}/lib must be set before CPG ELF compatibility scanning as well as execution
